nodes.label: NativeAssemblyAcceptance
nodes.responsibility: Check a concrete Godot composition of state, actions, event observation and native resource/scene substitution
nodes.authority: Game source owner and upstream Godot runtime
inputs: named Godot InputMap actions (move_left/move_right) and legal/illegal player actions
outputs: test evidence for bounded transitions and component substitution
nodes.behavioralContract: Native InputMap maps physical inputs to move_left/move_right; composition root translates actions into bounded grid rule calls, where only accepted transitions emit state_changed for view/audio. A rebound physical key preserves those rule/feedback consumers without changing the rules. Valid only for this tested finite scene/resource/input contract; no universal game, player-value or third-party script safety proof.
acceptance: Pinned Godot headless example boots as a real PackedScene.
Bounded action exhaustions preserve state invariants and goal behavior.
Player Resource and alternate presentation PackedScene substitute without changing rules; invalid configuration is rejected atomically.
Engine-native physical InputEvent dispatch and live InputMap rebinding preserve rule, view, and licensed-audio consumers; removed bindings do not cause state changes.

nodes.label: BevyNativeProductAssembly
nodes.responsibility: Compose one game-specific engine-independent Rust rule machine with upstream Bevy ECS, Plugin, input, sprite and text systems
nodes.authority: Game product rules owner; Bevy upstream engine owns ECS, renderer, schedules and input
outputs: bounded Rust rule and Bevy system test evidence
nodes.behavioralContract: Goal collection, hazard damage and restart are game-owned transitions; Bevy-native systems consume those rules. Cargo compile and test do not prove rendered GPU output or human enjoyment. Native FixedUpdate advances movement, collection and hazard rules while Update owns restart input and HUD; frame rate may change how many fixed steps occur in one rendered frame.
acceptance: Pin the actual Bevy version and Cargo.lock.
Native Rust rule and Bevy Plugin/system tests pass.
Compile Bevy application with cargo check --locked --all-targets; physical player input/output remains unverified without a graphical run.

Kani 0.68.0 verifies four actual Rust source harnesses; at 2026-11-08 four successfully verified, zero failed, 81 checks
Bevy native ECS consumer and compile acceptance stay mandatory for real engine-effect claims
Native TimeUpdateStrategy::FixedTimesteps(0) causes no collection in one display frame; FixedTimesteps(1) advances exactly one actual Bevy simulation step and HUD projection

nodes.label: GodotRoomAgentEpisode
